text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon's performance
at the Arima Kinen was truly breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: *Haah*... *haah*... *haah*...!

"A roaring wall of cheers, shouts, and applause...!
Formidable rivals standing side by side, footsteps, tremors...!"

"And above all, her phenomenal speed,
seized through sheer effort and talent...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Hahahaha!
Surpass it! Surpass it! Surpass it!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To the farthest reaches of potential dormant within this body!
Beyond the limits of comprehensible speed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Surpassing everything, and going even further! Even further beyond!
Right now, I know I can—!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place is Agnes Tachyon!
1st place goes to Agnes Tachyon!
(WAAAAAAAAH---!!!)
A roar of applause engulfed her after she finished the race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Tachyoooon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You're a legend!

Forgetting even to wave, she stared blankly up
at the crowd, her figure projected largely on the screen.

When I went to meet her in the underground tunnel,
she was standing there with a somewhat dazed expression.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah. That one, huh?
Man, this is embarrassing... on the big screen.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I was simply so overwhelmed with excitement
that I completely forgot how to act socially, you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
After all, the result was
as close to what I had envisioned as could be.
...Her sudden silence leaves me feeling uneasy.

She was magnificent at the Arima Kinen.
Everyone was captivated by her madness.
choice_data_list: (…Could it be the rebound from that…?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!
Ha-hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just suddenly overwhelmed with excitement!
It was magnificent, absolutely magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The research finally bore fruit!
Yes! Yes! We did it—!
Seeing her so unusually satisfied, frolicking with sheer joy, I couldn't help but smile.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops...
If it isn't Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, right now I really don't want to see your face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. Saying something like that after a loss
is rather emotional for you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It is truly hard to believe, though.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...As I was chasing after you, your back... overlapped with "that girl's."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And that... frustrates me
more than losing ever could...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Her imaginary friend and me?
Just what does "that girl" mean to her……?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In other words... one of a kind...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...My, my, what do we have here!
Now isn't this a fascinating research subject?"

—Though she looked satisfied just a moment ago,
before I knew it, she was lost in thought again
with that nihilistic grin of hers.
